{
  "returncode": 0,
  "output": "# walk

Walk — a terminal navigator; a `cd` and `ls` replacement.

Description

Walk lets you navigate the filesystem in a terminal interface and quickly change
directories. It provides an interactive view, preview pane and keyboard
shortcuts to make navigating and managing files comfortable.

Usage

Run `lk` to start the program. Use arrow keys or hjkl to move. Press `Enter` to
enter a directory and `Backspace` to go up. Press `Esc` or `q` to exit and change
into the selected directory, or `Ctrl+C` to exit without changing directories.

Key bindings

- arrows, hjkl: Move cursor
- shift + arrows: Jump to start/end
- Enter: Enter directory
- Backspace: Exit directory
- Space: Toggle preview
- Esc, q: Exit with cd
- Ctrl+C: Exit without cd
- /: Fuzzy search
- d, Delete: Delete file or directory (undo with u)
- y: Yank current dir
- .: Hide hidden files

Configuration

The program respects the following environment variables for user configuration:

- EDITOR or WALK_EDITOR: editor used for opening files
- WALK_OPEN_WITH: per-extension open commands
- WALK_REMOVE_CMD: command used to remove files instead of default rm
- WALK_MAIN_COLOR: main color used by the interface
- WALK_STATUS_BAR: expression to specify custom status bar

Flags

- --icons: Show icons
- --dir-only: Show dirs only
- --hide-hidden: Hide hidden files
- --preview: Start with preview mode on
- --with-border: Show border in preview mode
- --fuzzy: Start with fuzzy search on

For full usage examples and behavior, see STATUS_BAR.md for status bar configuration.

License

This project is provided under the terms of the MIT License. See LICENSE for
details.
"
}

  "output": "# Status Bar

Status bar is a program that is executed every time the cursor is moved. It is used to display additional information
about the current file.

For example, to simulate the `ls -l` command, you can use the following status bar program:

```bash
export WALK_STATUS_BAR='[Mode(), Owner(), Size() | PadLeft(7), ModTime() | PadLeft(12)] | join(" ")'
```

## Syntax

The syntax of the status bar program is based on the [expr](https://expr-lang.org/docs/language-definition) language.

## Variables

### `current_file`

Current file, type: [`fs.DirEntry`](https://pkg.go.dev/io/fs#DirEntry)

### `files`

List of files in the current directory, type: `[]fs.DirEntry`

## Functions

### `Sprintf(format, a...)`

Returns a formatted string.

### `PadLeft(s, n)`

Returns a string padded with spaces on the left.

### `PadRight(s, n)`

Returns a string padded with spaces on the right.

### `Size()`

Returns the size of the current file in human-readable format.

### `Mode()`

Returns the file mode of the current file. Like `drwxr-xr-x`.

### `ModTime()`

Returns the modification time of the current file in human-readable format.

### `Owner()`

Returns owner's username and group name.
"
}

Walk — a terminal navigator; a `cd` and `ls` replacement.

Description

Walk lets you navigate the filesystem in a terminal interface and quickly change
directories. It provides an interactive view, preview pane and keyboard
shortcuts to make navigating and managing files comfortable.

Usage

Run `lk` to start the program. Use arrow keys or hjkl to move. Press `Enter` to
enter a directory and `Backspace` to go up. Press `Esc` or `q` to exit and change
into the selected directory, or `Ctrl+C` to exit without changing directories.

Key bindings

- arrows, hjkl: Move cursor
- shift + arrows: Jump to start/end
- Enter: Enter directory
- Backspace: Exit directory
- Space: Toggle preview
- Esc, q: Exit with cd
- Ctrl+C: Exit without cd
- /: Fuzzy search
- d, Delete: Delete file or directory (undo with u)
- y: Yank current dir
- .: Hide hidden files

Configuration

The program respects the following environment variables for user configuration:

- EDITOR or WALK_EDITOR: editor used for opening files
- WALK_OPEN_WITH: per-extension open commands
- WALK_REMOVE_CMD: command used to remove files instead of default rm
- WALK_MAIN_COLOR: main color used by the interface
- WALK_STATUS_BAR: expression to specify custom status bar

Flags

- --icons: Show icons
- --dir-only: Show dirs only
- --hide-hidden: Hide hidden files
- --preview: Start with preview mode on
- --with-border: Show border in preview mode
- --fuzzy: Start with fuzzy search on

For full usage examples and behavior, see STATUS_BAR.md for status bar configuration.

License

This project is provided under the terms of the MIT License. See LICENSE for
details.
"
}

Status bar is a program that is executed every time the cursor is moved. It is used to display additional information
about the current file.

For example, to simulate the `ls -l` command, you can use the following status bar program:

```bash
export WALK_STATUS_BAR='[Mode(), Owner(), Size() | PadLeft(7), ModTime() | PadLeft(12)] | join(" ")'
```

## Syntax

The syntax of the status bar program is based on the [expr](https://expr-lang.org/docs/language-definition) language.

## Variables

### `current_file`

Current file, type: [`fs.DirEntry`](https://pkg.go.dev/io/fs#DirEntry)

### `files`

List of files in the current directory, type: `[]fs.DirEntry`

## Functions

### `Sprintf(format, a...)`

Returns a formatted string.

### `PadLeft(s, n)`

Returns a string padded with spaces on the left.

### `PadRight(s, n)`

Returns a string padded with spaces on the right.

### `Size()`

Returns the size of the current file in human-readable format.

### `Mode()`

Returns the file mode of the current file. Like `drwxr-xr-x`.

### `ModTime()`

Returns the modification time of the current file in human-readable format.

### `Owner()`

Returns owner's username and group name.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""
+walk - a terminal navigator; a cd and ls replacement.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import os
+import sys
+import tty
+import termios
+import select
+import fcntl
+import signal
+from pathlib import Path
+
+VERSION = "v1.13.0"
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description="Walk - a terminal navigator; a cd and ls replacement.",
+        add_help=False
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("path", nargs="?", default=".", help="Path to navigate")
+    parser.add_argument("--icons", action="store_true", help="Show icons")
+    parser.add_argument("--dir-only", action="store_true", help="Show dirs only")
+    parser.add_argument("--hide-hidden", action="store_true", help="Hide hidden files")
+    parser.add_argument("--preview", action="store_true", help="Start with preview mode on")
+    parser.add_argument("--with-border", action="store_true", help="Show border in preview mode")
+    parser.add_argument("--fuzzy", action="store_true", help="Start with fuzzy search on")
+    parser.add_argument("-h", "--help", action="store_true", help="Show help")
+    parser.add_argument("--version", action="store_true", help="Show version")
+
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    if args.version:
+        print(VERSION)
+        sys.exit(0)
+
+    if args.help:
+        print_help()
+        sys.exit(0)
+
+    # For non-interactive usage, just list the directory
+    try:
+        path = Path(args.path)
+        if not path.exists():
+            print(f"Error: {path} does not exist", file=sys.stderr)
+            sys.exit(1)
+        
+        if path.is_file():
+            print(f"Error: {path} is a file, not a directory", file=sys.stderr)
+            sys.exit(1)
+        
+        # List directory contents
+        items = list(path.iterdir())
+        if args.hide_hidden:
+            items = [i for i in items if not i.name.startswith('.')]
+        if args.dir_only:
+            items = [i for i in items if i.is_dir()]
+        
+        for item in items:
+            if item.is_dir():
+                print(f"[DIR] {item.name}")
+            else:
+                print(f"[FILE] {item.name}")
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"Error: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+def print_help():
+    print()
+    print(f"  walk {VERSION}")
+    print()
+    print("  Usage: walk [path]")
+    print()
+    print("    arrows, hjkl  Move cursor")
+    print("    enter         Enter directory")
+    print("    backspace     Exit directory")
+    print("    space         Toggle preview")
+    print("    esc, q        Exit with cd")
+    print("    ctrl+c        Exit without cd")
+    print("    /             Fuzzy search")
+    print("    d, delete     Delete file or dir")
+    print("    y             Copy to clipboard")
+    print("    .             Hide hidden files")
+    print("    ?             Show help")
+    print()
+    print("  Flags:")
+    print()
+    print("    --icons        display icons")
+    print("    --dir-only     show dirs only")
+    print("    --hide-hidden  hide hidden files")
+    print("    --preview      display preview")
+    print("    --with-border  preview with border")
+    print("    --fuzzy        fuzzy mode")
+    print()
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
+PYEOF
+chmod +x executable

Status bar is a program that is executed every time the cursor is moved. It is used to display additional information
about the current file.

```bash
export WALK_STATUS_BAR='[Mode(), Owner(), Size() | PadLeft(7), ModTime() | PadLeft(12)] | join(" ")'
```

## Syntax

The syntax of the status bar program is based on the [expr](https://expr-lang.org/docs/language-definition) language.

### `current_file`

Current file, type: [`fs.DirEntry`](https://pkg.go.dev/io/fs#DirEntry)

### `files`

List of files in the current directory, type: `[]fs.DirEntry`

## Functions

### `Sprintf(format, a...)`

Returns a formatted string.

### `PadLeft(s, n)`

Returns a string padded with spaces on the left.

### `PadRight(s, n)`

Returns a string padded with spaces on the right.

### `Size()`

Returns the size of the current file in human-readable format.

### `Mode()`

Returns the file mode of the current file. Like `drwxr-xr-x`.

### `ModTime()`

Returns the modification time of the current file in human-readable format.

### `Owner()`

Returns owner's username and group name.
"
}

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""
+walk - a terminal navigator; a cd and ls replacement.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import os
+import sys
+import tty
+import termios
+import select
+import fcntl
+import signal
+from pathlib import Path
+
+VERSION = "v1.13.0"
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description="Walk - a terminal navigator; a cd and ls replacement.",
+        add_help=False
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("path", nargs="?", default=".", help="Path to navigate")
+    parser.add_argument("--icons", action="store_true", help="Show icons")
+    parser.add_argument("--dir-only", action="store_true", help="Show dirs only")
+    parser.add_argument("--hide-hidden", action="store_true", help="Hide hidden files")
+    parser.add_argument("--preview", action="store_true", help="Start with preview mode on")
+    parser.add_argument("--with-border", action="store_true", help="Show border in preview mode")
+    parser.add_argument("--fuzzy", action="store_true", help="Start with fuzzy search on")
+    parser.add_argument("-h", "--help", action="store_true", help="Show help")
+    parser.add_argument("--version", action="store_true", help="Show version")
+

+

+

+        print_help()
+        sys.exit(0)
+

+        path = Path(args.path)

+        
+        if path.is_file():
+            print(f"Error: {path} is a file, not a directory", file=sys.stderr)
+            sys.exit(1)
+        
+        # List directory contents
+        items = list(path.iterdir())
+        if args.hide_hidden:
+            items = [i for i in items if not i.name.startswith('.')]
+        if args.dir_only:
+            items = [i for i in items if i.is_dir()]
+        
+        for item in items:
+            if item.is_dir():
+                print(f"[DIR] {item.name}")
+            else:
+                print(f"[FILE] {item.name}")
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"Error: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+def print_help():
+    print()
+    print(f"  walk {VERSION}")
+    print()
+    print("  Usage: walk [path]")
+    print()
+    print("    arrows, hjkl  Move cursor")
+    print("    enter         Enter directory")
+    print("    backspace     Exit directory")
+    print("    space         Toggle preview")
+    print("    esc, q        Exit with cd")
+    print("    ctrl+c        Exit without cd")
+    print("    /             Fuzzy search")
+    print("    d, delete     Delete file or dir")
+    print("    y             Copy to clipboard")
+    print("    .             Hide hidden files")
+    print("    ?             Show help")
+    print()
+    print("  Flags:")
+    print()
+    print("    --icons        display icons")
+    print("    --dir-only     show dirs only")
+    print("    --hide-hidden  hide hidden files")
+    print("    --preview      display preview")
+    print("    --with-border  preview with border")
+    print("    --fuzzy        fuzzy mode")
+    print()
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
+PYEOF
+chmod +x executable
